title: Pause / Abort command, Mobile to Unity (protocol 1)
description: JSON argument of UnitySendMessage("Fire3DBridge", "Pause" | "Abort", json). Pause when the app goes to the background (Unity also pauses itself and flushes its events); Abort stops the play; the session is then completed with endReason Abandoned (Assessment outcome Incomplete).

sessionId.description: Optional; when present it must be the running session.
